messages.content: Buoi Git/GitHub hom nay coi nhu xong, buoc tiep theo la RAG.
RAG = Retrieval-Augmented Generation, ket hop tim kiem va sinh cau tra loi.
Vector database hoat dong the nao?
Vector DB luu embedding va tim nhanh vector gan nhau bang thuat toan ANN.
Chunking la gi va vi sao can thiet?
Chunking la chia van ban dai thanh doan nho truoc khi embedding, tranh vector bi mo nhoe.
Da hoc xong ROW_NUMBER, RANK, va running SUM OVER ORDER BY.
Financial-transaction-analyzer dung thuat toan gi de phat hien outlier?
Dung ca mean+2xstd va IQR, vi mean+std co masking effect khi outlier lon.
